scenes.text: Every time you talk to Siri, send a voice note that gets typed out, or hear an AI voice read a story, [1] two technologies are at work. [2] Speech to text, and text to speech. So let's understand both.

title: Speech
AI
data.subtitle: Speech to text & text to speech

scenes.text: Think of them as two directions. [1] Speech to text listens to your voice, and writes it down as words. [2] Text to speech does the opposite. It takes words, and turns them into a natural sounding voice.

Here's how speech to text works. [1] Your voice is recorded as a sound wave. [2] That wave is turned into a picture of sound, called a spectrogram, which shows which pitches are loud at each moment. [3] A speech model reads that picture, a bit like reading an image, [4] and predicts the most likely words, in order, [5] giving you the final text.

data.heading: Speech to text
nodes: A picture of sound over time

scenes.text: And text to speech works in reverse. [1] It starts with your text. [2] First, the words are turned into sounds, the way they should be pronounced. [3] Then the model plans the rhythm, pitch and pauses, so it sounds natural. [4] It generates the actual sound wave, [5] and out comes a voice, just like the one you're hearing right now.

data.heading: Text to speech
nodes: Where to pause, what to stress

scenes.text: And you use these every day. [1] Voice typing, and voice notes that turn into text. [2] Auto captions on YouTube and Instagram. [3] And audiobooks, map directions, and AI phone assistants.

So what makes speech AI hard? [1] Accents, because the same word sounds different in Hyderabad, London and Texas. [2] Background noise, like traffic or a busy office. [3] Mixed languages, like switching between Telugu and English in one sentence. [4] And emotion, sounding happy, calm or serious at the right moment.

Here's a common myth. [1] People think AI voices are just recordings of real people, cut and joined together. [2] Not anymore. Modern AI voices are generated fresh, sound by sound, which is why they can say any sentence, even one nobody has ever said before.

data.myth: AI voices are just recordings, cut and joined.
data.fact: Modern AI voices are generated fresh, sound by sound, so they can say any sentence.

scenes.text: Let's recap. [1] Speech to text turns your voice into words. [2] It reads a spectrogram, a picture of sound. [3] Text to speech turns words back into a natural voice.
